verifier: Claude (Anthropic) as the lab agent: reading of the pinned text. Not a human review and not an author decision.
rule: Semantic verification gate: a finding, a FAIL of a reference example, a normative conflict, a systemic blocker or an author question gets that status only after the provisions involved are read against the literal pinned text. Codex drafts are never a source. Every quote below must occur verbatim (after markdown normalization) in the named document; 'absent' records a string that must not occur. Since 2026-10-08 every finding has a kind; contradictions carry a structured analysis (subject, object, scope, conditions, modality of each rule, priority rule, joint compliance); missing definitions list the documents, terms and reference chain searched.

classes.CONFIRMED_FINDING: the literal texts produce the defect (contradiction, broken reference, wrong number, missing definition) without any lab reading
classes.INTERPRETATION_GAP: the result depends on a reading or a definition the corpus does not give; no text is contradicted
classes.IMPLEMENTATION_BUG: the lab's own reading or code produced the reported defect; the texts do not
classes.UNVERIFIED_FINDING: recorded but not yet verified against the literal text (reported as such, never as a protocol defect)
